item.title: Three men jailed for total of 51 years over £1.1m Richmond watch robbery
item.description: Retail Jeweller Three men jailed for total of 51 years over £1.1m Richmond watch robbery Three men have been jailed for a combined total of 51 years following a Metropolitan Police investigation into a £1.1m robbery at a luxury watch shop in Richmond in May 2024. Three men jailed for total of 51 years over £1.1m Richmond watch robbery Ruth Faulkner

item.title: UK footfall benefits from January sales boost
item.description: Retail Jeweller UK footfall benefits from January sales boost UK retail footfall rose in January as consumers who had held off from Christmas spending snapped up bargains in the sales, according to the latest data from BRC-KPMG. UK footfall benefits from January sales boost Alex O'Dea

item.description: Retail Jeweller Sekonda expands cruise retail presence with Starboard Cruise Services partnership Sekonda Watches has announced a new partnership with Starboard Cruise Services, marking a further step in the brand’s expansion within the cruise retail sector. item.title: Namibia joins Luanda Accord as GJEPC and DMCC move toward Natural Diamond Council membership
item.description: Retail Jeweller Namibia joins Luanda Accord as GJEPC and DMCC move toward Natural Diamond Council membership The Republic of Namibia has become the latest government to sign the Luanda Accord, while India’s Gem and Jewellery Export Promotion Council (GJEPC) and the Dubai Multi Commodities Centre (DMCC) are set to move towards membership of the Natural Diamond Council (NDC). Namibia joins Luanda Accord as GJEPC and DMCC move toward Natural Diamond Council membership Ruth Faulkner

item.description: Retail Jeweller Royal Mail reminds SMEs to apply for its apprenticeship funding During National Apprenticeship Week (9 to 15 February), Royal Mail is reminding SMEs to apply for its apprenticeship levy transfer fund for small and medium-sized businesses. item.title: Trial of the Pyx held at Mansion House for first time in 777 year history
item.description: Retail Jeweller Trial of the Pyx held at Mansion House for first time in 777 year history The Lady Mayor of the City of London has welcomed the historic Trial of the Pyx to Mansion House for the first time in its 777 year history, as The Royal Mint submitted thousands of coins for independent testing. item.title: Kit Heath unveils Mirage Reflect collection for SS26
item.description: Retail Jeweller Kit Heath unveils Mirage Reflect collection for SS26 Silver jewellery brand Kit Heath has introduced Mirage Reflect, a new 15 piece jewellery collection for SS26, designed to offer retailers a contemporary, versatile silver and gold plated assortment focused on layered styling and everyday wearability. item.title: Tributes paid to industry legend David Doyle following his passing
item.description: Retail Jeweller Tributes paid to industry legend David Doyle following his passing Tributes have poured in from across the UK jewellery trade following the passing of industry legend David Doyle, a widely respected figure whose decades of dedication, leadership and fundraising left a lasting impact on the sector.
